about: One record, and the fingerprint all three implementations must give it (#177): the dashboard (tests/test_export_schema.py), examples/load_export.py and the server (server/tests/test_fingerprint.py). Integer-like keys, keys whose order differs between UTF-16 code units and code points, every volatile field at more than one depth, text that JSON and UTF-8 treat specially, and lone surrogates (in a key and in a value), which JSON.stringify writes as \u escapes. Regenerate only if the rule changes, and say why.
